    30→class AuditLevel(Enum):
    31→    """Severity/importance levels for audit entries"""
    32→    DEBUG = "debug"
    33→    INFO = "info"

    60→@dataclass
    61→class AuditEntry:
    62→    """Single audit log entry with hash chain integrity"""
    63→
    64→    # Core fields
    65→    timestamp_utc: str
    66→    level: AuditLevel
    67→    category: AuditCategory
    68→    operation: str
    69→    message: str
    70→
    71→    # Context
    72→    tool: str = ""
    73→    agent_id: str = ""
    74→    user_id: str = ""
    75→    session_id: str = ""
    76→    sequence_id: str = ""  # Shot/sequence being worked on
    77→
    78→    # Operation details
    79→    operation_id: str = ""
    80→    input_data: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    81→    output_data: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    82→    duration_ms: float = 0.0
    83→
    84→    # State tracking
    85→    before_state_hash: str = ""
    86→    after_state_hash: str = ""
    87→
    88→    # Hash chain (tamper evidence)
    89→    previous_hash: str = ""
    90→    entry_hash: str = ""
    91→
    92→    def __post_init__(self):
    93→        if not self.entry_hash:
    94→            self.entry_hash = self._compute_hash()
    95→
    96→    def _compute_hash(self) -> str:
    97→        """Compute SHA-256 hash of entry content"""
    98→        content = {
    99→            "timestamp_utc": self.timestamp_utc,
   100→            "level": self.level.value,
   101→            "category": self.category.value,
   102→            "operation": self.operation,
   103→            "message": self.message,
   104→            "tool": self.tool,
   105→            "agent_id": self.agent_id,
   106→            "operation_id": self.operation_id,
   107→            "previous_hash": self.previous_hash,
   108→        }
   109→        content_str = json.dumps(content, sort_keys=True)
   110→        return hashlib.sha256(content_str.encode('utf-8')).hexdigest()
   111→
   112→    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
   113→        """Convert to dictionary for serialization"""
   114→        return {
   115→            "timestamp_utc": self.timestamp_utc,
   116→            "level": self.level.value,
   117→            "category": self.category.value,
   118→            "operation": self.operation,
   119→            "message": self.message,
   120→            "tool": self.tool,
   121→            "agent_id": self.agent_id,
   122→            "user_id": self.user_id,
   123→            "session_id": self.session_id,
   124→            "sequence_id": self.sequence_id,
   125→            "operation_id": self.operation_id,
   126→            "input_data": self.input_data,
   127→            "output_data": self.output_data,
   128→            "duration_ms": self.duration_ms,
   129→            "before_state_hash": self.before_state_hash,
   130→            "after_state_hash": self.after_state_hash,
   131→            "previous_hash": self.previous_hash,
   132→            "entry_hash": self.entry_hash,
   133→        }
   134→
   135→    @classmethod
   136→    def from_dict(cls, data: Dict[str, Any]) -> 'AuditEntry':
   137→        """Create from dictionary"""
   138→        return cls(
   139→            timestamp_utc=data["timestamp_utc"],
   140→            level=AuditLevel(data["level"]),
   141→            category=AuditCategory(data["category"]),
   142→            operation=data["operation"],
   143→            message=data["message"],
   144→            tool=data.get("tool", ""),
   145→            agent_id=data.get("agent_id", ""),
   146→            user_id=data.get("user_id", ""),
   147→            session_id=data.get("session_id", ""),
   148→            sequence_id=data.get("sequence_id", ""),
   149→            operation_id=data.get("operation_id", ""),
   150→            input_data=data.get("input_data", {}),
   151→            output_data=data.get("output_data", {}),
   152→            duration_ms=data.get("duration_ms", 0.0),
   153→            before_state_hash=data.get("before_state_hash", ""),
   154→            after_state_hash=data.get("after_state_hash", ""),
   155→            previous_hash=data.get("previous_hash", ""),
   156→            entry_hash=data.get("entry_hash", ""),
   157→        )
   158→
   159→    def to_human_readable(self) -> str:
   160→        """Format for human reading"""
   161→        return (
   162→            f"[{self.timestamp_utc}] [{self.level.value.upper():8}] "
   163→            f"[{self.category.value}] {self.operation}: {self.message}"
   164→        )
   165→
   166→
   167→class AuditLog:
   168→    """
   169→    Thread-safe audit log with hash chain integrity.
   170→
   171→    Usage:
   172→        log = AuditLog.get_instance()
   173→        log.log_action("create_light", "Created key light", category=AuditCategory.LIGHTING)
   174→    """
   175→
   176→    _instance: Optional['AuditLog'] = None
   177→    _lock = threading.Lock()
   178→
   179→    def __init__(self, log_dir: Optional[Path] = None):
   180→        self._entries: List[AuditEntry] = []
   181→        self._log_dir = log_dir or Path.home() / ".synapse" / "audit"
   182→        self._log_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
   183→        self._current_session = deterministic_uuid(f"session:{id(self)}:{threading.current_thread().ident}", "session")
   184→        self._last_hash = "genesis"
   185→        self._write_lock = threading.Lock()
   186→
   187→        # Callbacks for real-time monitoring
   188→        self._callbacks: List[Callable[[AuditEntry], None]] = []
   189→
   190→        # Mtime-based hash chain verification cache
   191→        self._last_verify_mtime: float = 0.0
   192→        self._last_verify_result: Optional[Tuple[bool, Optional[int]]] = None
   193→
   194→    @classmethod
   195→    def get_instance(cls, log_dir: Optional[Path] = None) -> 'AuditLog':
   196→        """Get singleton instance"""
   197→        with cls._lock:
   198→            if cls._instance is None:
   199→                cls._instance = cls(log_dir)
   200→            return cls._instance
   201→
   202→    @classmethod
   203→    def reset_instance(cls) -> None:
   204→        """Reset singleton (for testing)"""
   205→        with cls._lock:
   206→            cls._instance = None
   207→
   208→    def add_callback(self, callback: Callable[[AuditEntry], None]) -> None:
   209→        """Add callback for real-time log monitoring"""
   210→        self._callbacks.append(callback)
   211→
   212→    def remove_callback(self, callback: Callable[[AuditEntry], None]) -> None:
   213→        """Remove callback"""
   214→        if callback in self._callbacks:
   215→            self._callbacks.remove(callback)
   216→
   217→    def log(
   218→        self,
   219→        operation: str,
   220→        message: str,
   221→        level: AuditLevel = AuditLevel.INFO,
   222→        category: AuditCategory = AuditCategory.SYSTEM,
   223→        tool: str = "",
   224→        agent_id: str = "",
   225→        user_id: str = "",
   226→        operation_id: str = "",
   227→        input_data: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
   228→        output_data: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
   229→        sequence_id: str = "",
   230→    ) -> AuditEntry:
   231→        """
   232→        Log an audit entry.
   233→
   234→        Args:
   235→            operation: Name of operation (e.g., "create_light_group")
   236→            message: Human-readable description
   237→            level: Severity level
   238→            category: Category for filtering
   239→            tool: Tool name (e.g., "synapse", "engram")
   240→            agent_id: ID of AI agent (if applicable)
   241→            operation_id: Unique operation ID for correlation
   242→            input_data: Input parameters
   243→            output_data: Output/result data
   244→            sequence_id: Shot/sequence identifier
   245→
   246→        Returns:
   247→            Created AuditEntry
   248→        """
   249→        with self._write_lock:
   250→            entry = AuditEntry(
   251→                timestamp_utc=time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ", time.gmtime()),
   252→                level=level,
   253→                category=category,
   254→                operation=operation,
   255→                message=message,
   256→                tool=tool,
   257→                agent_id=agent_id,
   258→                user_id=user_id,
   259→                session_id=self._current_session,
   260→                sequence_id=sequence_id,
   261→                operation_id=operation_id or deterministic_uuid(f"{operation}:{message}"),
   262→                input_data=input_data or {},
   263→                output_data=output_data or {},
   264→                previous_hash=self._last_hash,
   265→            )
   266→
   267→            self._entries.append(entry)
   268→            self._last_hash = entry.entry_hash
   269→
   270→            # Write to disk
   271→            self._persist_entry(entry)
   272→
   273→            # Notify callbacks
   274→            for callback in self._callbacks:
   275→                try:
   276→                    callback(entry)
   277→                except Exception:
   278→                    pass  # Don't let callback errors break logging
   279→
   280→            return entry
   281→
   282→    def log_agent_action(
   283→        self,
   284→        operation: str,
   285→        message: str,
   286→        agent_id: str,
   287→        category: AuditCategory,
   288→        **kwargs
   289→    ) -> AuditEntry:
   290→        """Convenience method for agent actions"""
   291→        return self.log(
   292→            operation=operation,
   293→            message=message,
   294→            level=AuditLevel.AGENT_ACTION,
   295→            category=category,
   296→            agent_id=agent_id,
   297→            **kwargs
   298→        )
   299→
   300→    def log_human_decision(
   301→        self,
   302→        operation: str,
   303→        message: str,
   304→        user_id: str,
   305→        category: AuditCategory,
   306→        **kwargs
   307→    ) -> AuditEntry:
   308→        """Convenience method for human decisions"""
   309→        entry = self.log(
   310→            operation=operation,
   311→            message=message,
   312→            level=AuditLevel.HUMAN_DECISION,
   313→            category=category,
   314→            **kwargs
   315→        )
   316→        entry.user_id = user_id
   317→        return entry
   318→
   319→    def _persist_entry(self, entry: AuditEntry) -> None:
   320→        """Write entry to disk (hash computed on plaintext before encryption)"""
   321→        # Daily log files
   322→        date_str = entry.timestamp_utc[:10]
   323→        log_file = self._log_dir / f"audit_{date_str}.jsonl"
   324→
   325→        line = json.dumps(entry.to_dict(), sort_keys=True)
   326→        crypto = CryptoEngine.get_instance() if ENCRYPTION_AVAILABLE else None
   327→        if crypto:
   328→            line = crypto.encrypt_line(line)
   329→
   330→        with open(log_file, 'a', encoding='utf-8') as f:
   331→            f.write(line + '\n')
   332→
   333→    def get_entries(
   334→        self,
   335→        level: Optional[AuditLevel] = None,
   336→        category: Optional[AuditCategory] = None,
   337→        operation: Optional[str] = None,
   338→        agent_id: Optional[str] = None,
   339→        sequence_id: Optional[str] = None,
   340→        since: Optional[str] = None,
   341→        limit: int = 100,
   342→    ) -> List[AuditEntry]:
   343→        """Query audit entries with filters"""
   344→        results = []
   345→
   346→        for entry in reversed(self._entries):
   347→            if level and entry.level != level:
   348→                continue
   349→            if category and entry.category != category:
   350→                continue
   351→            if operation and entry.operation != operation:
   352→                continue
   353→            if agent_id and entry.agent_id != agent_id:
   354→                continue
   355→            if sequence_id and entry.sequence_id != sequence_id:
   356→                continue
   357→            if since and entry.timestamp_utc < since:
   358→                continue
   359→
   360→            results.append(entry)
   361→            if len(results) >= limit:
   362→                break
   363→
   364→        return results
   365→
   366→    def verify_chain(self) -> Tuple[bool, Optional[int]]:
   367→        """
   368→        Verify hash chain integrity.
   369→
   370→        Uses file mtime to skip re-verification when the audit log
   371→        has not been modified since the last successful check.
   372→
   373→        Returns:
   374→            (is_valid, first_invalid_index)
   375→        """
   376→        # Check if any audit file has been modified since last verification
   377→        current_mtime = self._get_latest_mtime()
   378→        if (
   379→            self._last_verify_result is not None
   380→            and current_mtime <= self._last_verify_mtime
   381→            and len(self._entries) > 0
   382→        ):
   383→            return self._last_verify_result
   384→
   385→        expected_hash = "genesis"
   386→
   387→        for i, entry in enumerate(self._entries):
   388→            if entry.previous_hash != expected_hash:
   389→                result = (False, i)
   390→                self._last_verify_mtime = current_mtime
   391→                self._last_verify_result = result
   392→                return result
   393→            expected_hash = entry.entry_hash
   394→
   395→        result = (True, None)
   396→        self._last_verify_mtime = current_mtime
   397→        self._last_verify_result = result
   398→        return result
   399→
   400→    def _get_latest_mtime(self) -> float:
   401→        """Get the most recent mtime across all audit log files."""
   402→        try:
   403→            mtimes = [f.stat().st_mtime for f in self._log_dir.glob("audit_*.jsonl")]
   404→            return max(mtimes) if mtimes else 0.0
   405→        except OSError:
   406→            return 0.0
   407→
   408→    def export_session(self, session_id: Optional[str] = None) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
   409→        """Export all entries for a session"""
   410→        target_session = session_id or self._current_session
   411→        return [
   412→            entry.to_dict()
   413→            for entry in self._entries
   414→            if entry.session_id == target_session
   415→        ]
   416→
   417→    def replay_info(self, operation_id: str) -> Optional[Dict[str, Any]]:
   418→        """Get info needed to replay an operation"""
   419→        for entry in self._entries:
   420→            if entry.operation_id == operation_id:
   421→                return {
   422→                    "operation": entry.operation,
   423→                    "input_data": entry.input_data,
   424→                    "before_state_hash": entry.before_state_hash,
   425→                    "expected_output": entry.output_data,
   426→                    "expected_after_hash": entry.after_state_hash,
   427→                }
   428→        return None
   429→
   430→
   431→# Convenience function for global log access
   432→def audit_log() -> AuditLog:
   433→    """Get global audit log instance"""
   434→    return AuditLog.get_instance()

1→"""
     2→Synapse Human Gate System
     3→
     4→Human-in-the-loop approval checkpoints for AI agent workflows.
     5→Designed for per-sequence batch approval (faster, more trust).
     6→
     7→Gate Levels:
     8→- INFORM: Log only, no approval needed
     9→- REVIEW: Collect for batch review, continue work
    10→- APPROVE: Pause and require explicit approval before continuing
    11→- CRITICAL: Stop everything, require approval with confirmation
    12→"""
    13→
    14→import json
    15→import time
    16→import threading
    17→from pathlib import Path
    18→from dataclasses import dataclass, field
    19→from typing import Optional, List, Dict, Any, Callable, Tuple
    20→from enum import Enum
    21→
    22→from .determinism import deterministic_uuid
    23→from .audit import audit_log, AuditLevel, AuditCategory
    24→
    25→try:
    26→    from .crypto import CryptoEngine, ENCRYPTION_AVAILABLE
    27→except ImportError:
    28→    ENCRYPTION_AVAILABLE = False
    29→
    30→
    31→class GateLevel(Enum):
    32→    """Approval requirement levels"""
    33→    INFORM = "inform"        # Just log it
    34→    REVIEW = "review"        # Batch review later
    35→    APPROVE = "approve"      # Need approval to continue
    36→    CRITICAL = "critical"    # Full stop, confirm twice
    37→
    38→
    39→class GateDecision(Enum):
    40→    """Human decisions at gates"""
    41→    PENDING = "pending"
    42→    APPROVED = "approved"
    43→    REJECTED = "rejected"
    44→    MODIFIED = "modified"    # Approved with changes
    45→    DEFERRED = "deferred"    # Review later
    46→
    47→
    48→@dataclass
    49→class GateProposal:
    50→    """A proposed action awaiting human review"""
    51→
    52→    # Identity
    53→    proposal_id: str
    54→    gate_id: str
    55→    sequence_id: str
    56→
    57→    # What's being proposed
    58→    operation: str
    59→    description: str
    60→    category: AuditCategory
    61→    level: GateLevel
    62→
    63→    # Details
    64→    proposed_changes: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    65→    preview_data: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    66→    rollback_data: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    67→
    68→    # Agent context
    69→    agent_id: str = ""
    70→    reasoning: str = ""
    71→    confidence: float = 0.0  # 0-1, agent's confidence in proposal
    72→
    73→    # Timing
    74→    created_at: str = ""
    75→    expires_at: str = ""  # Optional deadline
    76→
    77→    # Decision tracking
    78→    decision: GateDecision = GateDecision.PENDING
    79→    decided_by: str = ""
    80→    decided_at: str = ""
    81→    decision_notes: str = ""
    82→    modified_changes: Dict[str, Any] = field(default_factory=dict)
    83→
    84→    def __post_init__(self):
    85→        if not self.created_at:
    86→            self.created_at = time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ", time.gmtime())
    87→        if not self.proposal_id:
    88→            content = f"{self.gate_id}:{self.operation}:{self.created_at}"
    89→            self.proposal_id = deterministic_uuid(content, "proposal")
    90→
    91→    def to_dict(self) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    92→        """Serialize for storage/transmission"""
    93→        return {
    94→            "proposal_id": self.proposal_id,
    95→            "gate_id": self.gate_id,
    96→            "sequence_id": self.sequence_id,
    97→            "operation": self.operation,
    98→            "description": self.description,
    99→            "category": self.category.value,

   283→        """
   284→        Propose a change for human review.
   285→

   288→        For APPROVE/CRITICAL: would block (but we return proposal for async handling)
   289→

   377→    def mark_batch_ready(self, sequence_id: str) -> Optional[GateBatch]:
   378→        """Mark batch as ready for review"""
   379→        batch = self._batches.get(sequence_id)
   380→        if batch:
   381→            batch.status = "ready"
   382→
   383→            audit_log().log(
   384→                operation="batch_ready",
   385→                message=f"Batch ready for review: {batch.pending_count()} proposals",
   386→                level=AuditLevel.INFO,

   400→    def decide(
   401→        self,
   402→        proposal_id: str,
   403→        decision: GateDecision,
   404→        user_id: str,
   405→        notes: str = "",
   406→        modified_changes: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None,
   407→    ) -> Optional[GateProposal]:
   408→        """
   409→        Record human decision on a proposal.
   410→
   411→        Args:
   412→            proposal_id: ID of proposal to decide
   413→            decision: The decision (APPROVED, REJECTED, MODIFIED, DEFERRED)
   414→            user_id: Who made the decision
   415→            notes: Optional notes explaining decision
   416→            modified_changes: If MODIFIED, the adjusted changes
   417→
   418→        Returns:
   419→            Updated proposal or None if not found
   420→        """
   421→        with self._write_lock:
   422→            proposal = self._proposals.get(proposal_id)
   423→            if not proposal:
   424→                return None
   425→
   426→            proposal.decision = decision
   427→            proposal.decided_by = user_id
   428→            proposal.decided_at = time.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ", time.gmtime())
   429→            proposal.decision_notes = notes

   431→            if decision == GateDecision.MODIFIED and modified_changes:
   432→                proposal.modified_changes = modified_changes
   433→
   434→            # Audit log
   435→            audit_level = AuditLevel.GATE_APPROVAL if decision in (
   436→                GateDecision.APPROVED, GateDecision.MODIFIED
   437→            ) else AuditLevel.GATE_REJECTION
   438→
   439→            audit_log().log_human_decision(
   440→                operation="gate_decision",
   441→                message=f"[{decision.value.upper()}] {proposal.operation}: {notes or 'No notes'}",
   442→                user_id=user_id,
   443→                category=proposal.category,
   444→                sequence_id=proposal.sequence_id,
   445→                input_data={
   446→                    "proposal_id": proposal_id,
   447→                    "decision": decision.value,
   448→                    "original_changes": proposal.proposed_changes,
   449→                    "modified_changes": modified_changes,
   450→                },
   451→            )
   452→
   453→            # Persist
   454→            self._persist_proposal(proposal)
   455→
   456→            # Notify callbacks
   457→            for callback in self._on_decision:

   465→    def decide_batch(
   466→        self,
   467→        sequence_id: str,
   468→        decisions: Dict[str, Tuple[GateDecision, str]],  # proposal_id -> (decision, notes)
   469→        user_id: str,
   470→    ) -> GateBatch:
   471→        """
   472→        Decide on entire batch at once.
   473→
   474→        Args:
   475→            sequence_id: Sequence batch to decide
   476→            decisions: Map of proposal_id to (decision, notes)
   477→            user_id: Who made decisions
   478→
   479→        Returns:
   480→            Updated batch
   481→        """
   482→        batch = self._batches.get(sequence_id)
   483→        if not batch:
   484→            raise ValueError(f"No batch for sequence: {sequence_id}")
   485→
   486→        batch.status = "reviewing"
   487→
   488→        for proposal in batch.proposals:
   489→            if proposal.proposal_id in decisions:
   490→                decision, notes = decisions[proposal.proposal_id]
   491→                self.decide(proposal.proposal_id, decision, user_id, notes)
   492→
   493→        batch.status = "completed"
   494→        return batch

   496→    def approve_all(self, sequence_id: str, user_id: str, notes: str = "") -> GateBatch:

   499→        if not batch:
   500→            raise ValueError(f"No batch for sequence: {sequence_id}")
   501→
   502→        decisions = {
   503→            p.proposal_id: (GateDecision.APPROVED, notes)
   504→            for p in batch.proposals
   505→            if p.decision == GateDecision.PENDING
   506→        }
   507→
   508→        return self.decide_batch(sequence_id, decisions, user_id)

   510→    def reject_all(self, sequence_id: str, user_id: str, notes: str = "") -> GateBatch:
   511→        """Reject all pending proposals in batch"""
   512→        batch = self._batches.get(sequence_id)
   513→        if not batch:
   514→            raise ValueError(f"No batch for sequence: {sequence_id}")
   515→
   516→        decisions = {
   517→            p.proposal_id: (GateDecision.REJECTED, notes)
   518→            for p in batch.proposals
   519→            if p.decision == GateDecision.PENDING
   520→        }
   521→
   522→        return self.decide_batch(sequence_id, decisions, user_id)

   529→        """Get all pending proposals, optionally filtered by sequence"""
